units.id: mission:Sad Gamblers - Republic|Passing through the spaceport you see a sizable group of people waiting on a lottery draw. You hear a whoop of success, and your attention is drawn as one of them wins a moderate sum in a 12th division win. It's one or two days' worth of standard pay.|25|0
units.english: Passing through the spaceport you see a sizable group of people waiting on a lottery draw. You hear a whoop of success, and your attention is drawn as one of them wins a moderate sum in a 12th division win. It's one or two days' worth of standard pay.
units.italian: Attraversando lo spazioporto vedi un gruppo consistente di persone in attesa di un'estrazione della lotteria. Senti un urlo di gioia, e la tua attenzione è catturata quando uno di loro vince una somma modesta con una vincita di dodicesima categoria. È il valore di uno o due giorni di paga normale.

units.id: mission:Sad Gamblers - Republic|	It's difficult not to pity them as they immediately buy more tickets with the whole value.|26|0
units.english: It's difficult not to pity them as they immediately buy more tickets with the whole value.
units.italian: È difficile non provare pietà mentre ricomprano subito altri biglietti con l'intera somma.

units.id: mission:Sad Gamblers - Syndicate|Passing through the spaceport you see a sizable group of people waiting on a lottery draw. You hear a whoop of success, and your attention is drawn as one of them wins a moderate sum in a 12th division win. It's one or two days' worth of standard pay.|39|0
units.english: Passing through the spaceport you see a sizable group of people waiting on a lottery draw. You hear a whoop of success, and your attention is drawn as one of them wins a moderate sum in a 12th division win. It's one or two days' worth of standard pay.
units.italian: Attraversando lo spazioporto vedi un gruppo consistente di persone in attesa di un'estrazione della lotteria. Senti un urlo di gioia, e la tua attenzione è catturata quando uno di loro vince una somma modesta con una vincita di dodicesima categoria. È il valore di uno o due giorni di paga normale.

units.id: mission:Sad Gamblers - Syndicate|	It's difficult not to pity them as they immediately buy more tickets with the whole value.|40|0
units.english: It's difficult not to pity them as they immediately buy more tickets with the whole value.
units.italian: È difficile non provare pietà mentre ricomprano subito altri biglietti con l'intera somma.

units.id: mission:Foiled Kidnapping Witnessed|A roadblock interrupts your path as you make your way towards the city, forcing you to slow down as you pass by, able to see what the commotion is about. Police wave past car after car coming from the other direction, looking into the vehicles until one gets pulled over to the side, causing police to briefly halt all traffic movements. The driver seems distressed, refusing to open the back even when he is being detained; his face goes pale when a little girl is found inside.|55|0
units.english: A roadblock interrupts your path as you make your way towards the city, forcing you to slow down as you pass by, able to see what the commotion is about. Police wave past car after car coming from the other direction, looking into the vehicles until one gets pulled over to the side, causing police to briefly halt all traffic movements. The driver seems distressed, refusing to open the back even when he is being detained; his face goes pale when a little girl is found inside.
units.italian: Un posto di blocco interrompe il tuo percorso mentre ti avvii verso la città, costringendoti a rallentare al passaggio, abbastanza da capire di cosa si tratta. La polizia fa passare un'auto dopo l'altra provenienti dalla direzione opposta, guardando dentro i veicoli finché uno non viene tirato da parte, il che blocca brevemente tutto il traffico. Il conducente sembra in difficoltà e rifiuta di aprire il bagagliaio anche quando viene fermato; il suo viso diventa pallido quando dentro viene trovata una bambina.

units.id: mission:Foiled Kidnapping Witnessed|	You're not sure how to feel about this when the police wave you off, blocking your view from the scene.|56|0
units.english: You're not sure how to feel about this when the police wave you off, blocking your view from the scene.
units.italian: Non sai bene cosa provare quando la polizia ti fa cenno di andare, togliendoti la vista della scena.

units.id: mission:Gift Store Interaction|As you wander the spaceport with a snack, waiting for your ship to be refueled, you pass a local souvenir shop and poke your head in to kill a little time. You see a decent looking mug with the text "Peace, Prosperity, Progress" printed underneath the insignia of the Deep and pick it up to see how it feels. The handle is solid, not too small for your fingers, and the lip of it looks like it would be comfortable to drink out of.|72|0
units.english: As you wander the spaceport with a snack, waiting for your ship to be refueled, you pass a local souvenir shop and poke your head in to kill a little time. You see a decent looking mug with the text "Peace, Prosperity, Progress" printed underneath the insignia of the Deep and pick it up to see how it feels. The handle is solid, not too small for your fingers, and the lip of it looks like it would be comfortable to drink out of.
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto con uno spuntino, aspettando che la nave faccia rifornimento, passi davanti a un negozio di souvenir locale e ficchi la testa dentro per ammazzare un po' il tempo. Vedi una tazza dall'aspetto decoroso con la scritta "Pace, Prosperità, Progresso" stampata sotto l'insegna del Deep e la prendi in mano per sentire com'è. Il manico è solido, non troppo piccolo per le tue dita, e il bordo sembra comodo per bere.

units.id: mission:Gift Store Interaction|	Two young adults wander into the aisle just a couple of meters away, conversing in a language that you don't understand, one that is perhaps local to the Deep. They're cooing over an item they've found, but when one flips it over to look at the price tag, there is an immediate exchange of looks and expressions that does not require translation. The item ends up back on the shelf with a giggle and a headshake.|73|0
units.english: Two young adults wander into the aisle just a couple of meters away, conversing in a language that you don't understand, one that is perhaps local to the Deep. They're cooing over an item they've found, but when one flips it over to look at the price tag, there is an immediate exchange of looks and expressions that does not require translation. The item ends up back on the shelf with a giggle and a headshake.
units.italian: Due giovani adulti entrano nel corridoio a un paio di metri da te, parlando in una lingua che non capisci, forse locale del Deep. Tubano su un oggetto che hanno trovato, ma quando uno lo gira per guardare il cartellino del prezzo c'è uno scambio immediato di sguardi ed espressioni che non ha bisogno di traduzione. L'oggetto torna sullo scaffale fra una risatina e un cenno del capo.

units.id: mission:Gift Store Interaction|	Curious, you turn over your own mug and see that it is indeed at least five times what you would expect to pay for a mug, even a good one: 50 credits. Still, it is certainly a novelty...|76|0
units.english: Curious, you turn over your own mug and see that it is indeed at least five times what you would expect to pay for a mug, even a good one: 50 credits. Still, it is certainly a novelty...
units.italian: Curioso, giri anche la tua tazza e vedi che costa davvero almeno cinque volte quello che ti aspetteresti di pagare per una tazza, anche buona: 50 crediti. Comunque è senz'altro una curiosità...

units.id: mission:Gift Store Interaction|	(Buy the mug.)|78|0
units.english: (Buy the mug.)
units.italian: (Compra la tazza.)

units.id: mission:Gift Store Interaction|	(Put it back.)|80|0
units.english: (Put it back.)
units.italian: (Rimettila a posto.)

units.id: mission:Gift Store Interaction|	You roll your eyes and put it back. Some experiences really are universal.|81|0
units.english: You roll your eyes and put it back. Some experiences really are universal.
units.italian: Alzi gli occhi al cielo e la rimetti a posto. Certe esperienze sono davvero universali.

units.id: mission:Gift Store Interaction|	You purchase the mug on an impulse. At least you can ditch your other one with a chip in it.|88|0
units.english: You purchase the mug on an impulse. At least you can ditch your other one with a chip in it.
units.italian: Compri la tazza d'impulso. Almeno puoi buttare quella che hai, che ha una scheggiatura.

units.id: mission:Gift Store Interaction|	Curious, you turn over your own mug, and when you spot the 50 credit price tag your heart sinks. You could never afford such an expensive mug. You put it back and walk away while pondering your financial situation.|92|0
units.english: Curious, you turn over your own mug, and when you spot the 50 credit price tag your heart sinks. You could never afford such an expensive mug. You put it back and walk away while pondering your financial situation.
units.italian: Curioso, giri la tua tazza e quando vedi il cartellino di 50 crediti ti si stringe il cuore. Non potresti mai permetterti una tazza così costosa. La rimetti a posto e ti allontani riflettendo sulla tua situazione finanziaria.

units.id: mission:New China Mourners|The skies pour down onto the world below, weeping together with the crowds as a plain but stately coffin is carried slowly from a void deck. Rhythmic wailing blends with the susurrant rain, filling the air as the coffin is followed closely by procession of mourners that look to be an extensive gathering of family. Even as it is placed into the van they do not leave the departed, a number of their hands placed on it as if pushing the person toward their final resting place. The two foremost mourners, a woman and a young man, climb in and take their seats next to it. Somewhere nearby, music begins to play as the vehicle slowly moves off.|105|0
units.english: The skies pour down onto the world below, weeping together with the crowds as a plain but stately coffin is carried slowly from a void deck. Rhythmic wailing blends with the susurrant rain, filling the air as the coffin is followed closely by procession of mourners that look to be an extensive gathering of family. Even as it is placed into the van they do not leave the departed, a number of their hands placed on it as if pushing the person toward their final resting place. The two foremost mourners, a woman and a young man, climb in and take their seats next to it. Somewhere nearby, music begins to play as the vehicle slowly moves off.
units.italian: Il cielo si rovescia sul mondo sotto, piangendo insieme alla folla mentre una bara semplice ma imponente viene portata lentamente fuori da un pianterreno aperto. Un lamento ritmico si mescola alla pioggia sussurrante e riempie l'aria, mentre la bara è seguita da vicino da un corteo di persone in lutto che sembra un raduno esteso di famiglia. Anche quando viene sistemata nel furgone non lasciano il defunto: molte mani si posano su di essa come per spingere la persona verso il suo ultimo riposo. I due in lutto più avanti, una donna e un giovane, salgono e prendono posto accanto alla bara. Da qualche parte vicino comincia la musica, mentre il veicolo si muove lentamente.

units.id: mission:New China Mourners|	You wonder how well known the person was before they died as those remaining finally turn away from the van receding into the distance and begin to file past some discreet attendants you hadn't noticed at first, accepting slippers for their bare feet before boarding the buses waiting to take them after the van.|106|0
units.english: You wonder how well known the person was before they died as those remaining finally turn away from the van receding into the distance and begin to file past some discreet attendants you hadn't noticed at first, accepting slippers for their bare feet before boarding the buses waiting to take them after the van.
units.italian: Ti chiedi quanto fosse conosciuta la persona prima di morire, mentre quelli rimasti si voltano infine dal furgone che si allontana e cominciano a passare davanti ad alcuni addetti discreti che non avevi notato subito, accettando pantofole per i piedi scalzi prima di salire sugli autobus che li porteranno dietro al furgone.

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|The smell of burning metal fills the air as you walk down the uncrowded streets of the factory town near the spaceport, keeping away from the arterial supply route directly feeding the port and its hangars.|119|0
units.english: The smell of burning metal fills the air as you walk down the uncrowded streets of the factory town near the spaceport, keeping away from the arterial supply route directly feeding the port and its hangars.
units.italian: L'odore di metallo bruciato riempie l'aria mentre percorri le strade poco affollate della città-fabbrica vicino allo spazioporto, tenendoti lontano dalla via di rifornimento principale che alimenta direttamente il porto e i suoi hangar.

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	Despite the distance and absent traffic though, it is far from quiet. Several factory buildings make discernible thrumming noises, and grinders echo amidst the silence as you investigate. Turning a corner, you come across an alley running along a lengthy chain link fence line. Beyond it, you can see a throng of men cutting away at a spaceship. Parts regularly fall to the floor, the workers apparently heedless of those below.|120|0
units.english: Despite the distance and absent traffic though, it is far from quiet. Several factory buildings make discernible thrumming noises, and grinders echo amidst the silence as you investigate. Turning a corner, you come across an alley running along a lengthy chain link fence line. Beyond it, you can see a throng of men cutting away at a spaceship. Parts regularly fall to the floor, the workers apparently heedless of those below.
units.italian: Nonostante la distanza e l'assenza di traffico, però, non è affatto silenzioso. Diversi edifici industriali producono un ronzio distinguibile, e mentre indaghi senti l'eco delle molatrici nel silenzio. Girato l'angolo, trovi un vicolo che corre lungo una lunga recinzione a maglie metalliche. Oltre, vedi una folla di uomini che tagliano una nave spaziale. Pezzi cadono regolarmente a terra, e gli operai sembrano incuranti di chi sta sotto.

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	Even as you watch you see a hull plate swinging dangerously above a workers head.|121|0
units.english: Even as you watch you see a hull plate swinging dangerously above a workers head.
units.italian: Anche mentre guardi, vedi una lastra di scafo oscillare pericolosamente sopra la testa di un operaio.

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	(Call out a warning.)|123|0
units.english: (Call out a warning.)
units.italian: (Grida un avvertimento.)

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	(Leave them be.)|124|0
units.english: (Leave them be.)
units.italian: (Lasciali stare.)

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	You call out a warning and most of the men pause to look at you, the hull plate swinging gently as the holder of the offending grinder squints in your direction. One of the older men, who you now realize was at least somewhat overseeing the activity, steps forward and flicks his hands at you in a shooing motion. "Oi you, piss off. We've got our safety supervisor, we don't need your nose in our business."|126|0
units.english: You call out a warning and most of the men pause to look at you, the hull plate swinging gently as the holder of the offending grinder squints in your direction. One of the older men, who you now realize was at least somewhat overseeing the activity, steps forward and flicks his hands at you in a shooing motion. "Oi you, piss off. We've got our safety supervisor, we don't need your nose in our business."
units.italian: Gridi un avvertimento e la maggior parte degli uomini si ferma a guardarti; la lastra oscilla piano mentre chi tiene la mola incriminata socchiude gli occhi verso di te. Uno degli uomini più anziani, che ora capisci sovrintendeva almeno in parte l'attività, fa un passo avanti e ti fa un gesto con le mani come per scacciarti. "Ehi tu, levati di torno. Abbiamo il nostro addetto alla sicurezza, non ci serve il tuo naso nei nostri affari."

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	(Challenge the claim.)|128|0
units.english: (Challenge the claim.)
units.italian: (Contesta l'affermazione.)

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	(Leave them be.)|129|0
units.english: (Leave them be.)
units.italian: (Lasciali stare.)

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	You point out that what you were seeing did not look at all safe, supervised or not, and the man glances around briefly before huffily making his way over to stand opposite you behind the fence. "Look stranger," he says, "work here is hard to find. For those working here, we don't have the time to spare. But the pay is good and we can at least feed our kids. Sure, some people get a few scrapes and bruises, but no one has died on my watch, and Rik only lost his smallest finger. If you feel the need to watch then fine, stand around, but leave us be, okay? There ain't no one around here that'll care what you have to say anyway."|131|0
units.english: You point out that what you were seeing did not look at all safe, supervised or not, and the man glances around briefly before huffily making his way over to stand opposite you behind the fence. "Look stranger," he says, "work here is hard to find. For those working here, we don't have the time to spare. But the pay is good and we can at least feed our kids. Sure, some people get a few scrapes and bruises, but no one has died on my watch, and Rik only lost his smallest finger. If you feel the need to watch then fine, stand around, but leave us be, okay? There ain't no one around here that'll care what you have to say anyway."
units.italian: Fai notare che quello che vedevi non sembrava affatto sicuro, controllo o no, e l'uomo si guarda intorno un istante prima di avvicinarsi stizzito e fermarsi di fronte a te, dietro la recinzione. "Senti, straniero", dice, "qui il lavoro è difficile da trovare. Quelli che lavorano qui non hanno tempo da perdere. Ma la paga è buona e almeno possiamo sfamare i nostri figli. Certo, qualcuno si fa qualche graffio e qualche livido, ma nessuno è morto sotto la mia sorveglianza, e Rik ha perso solo il dito più piccolo. Se ti va di guardare, va bene, resta lì in giro, ma lasciaci in pace, ok? Tanto qui non c'è nessuno a cui importi quello che hai da dire."

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	He looks you dead in the eyes, and once he is sure you understand his message he stomps back over to his crew, who continue their work. You watch them cut the dead ship apart until its pieces completely fill the trailer they have with them, before they proceed to haul the parts away to a factory in the distance.|132|0
units.english: He looks you dead in the eyes, and once he is sure you understand his message he stomps back over to his crew, who continue their work. You watch them cut the dead ship apart until its pieces completely fill the trailer they have with them, before they proceed to haul the parts away to a factory in the distance.
units.italian: Ti guarda dritto negli occhi, e quando è sicuro che tu abbia capito il messaggio torna a passi pesanti dalla sua squadra, che riprende il lavoro. Li guardi smontare la nave morta finché i pezzi riempiono completamente il rimorchio che hanno con sé, poi si portano via le parti verso una fabbrica in lontananza.

units.id: mission:New Holland Foibles|	You turn and depart. A moment later you hear a clatter and a shout, but when you look back no one appears to have been injured.|135|0
units.english: You turn and depart. A moment later you hear a clatter and a shout, but when you look back no one appears to have been injured.
units.italian: Ti volti e te ne vai. Un momento dopo senti un fragore e un grido, ma quando ti volti indietro nessuno sembra essersi fatto male.

units.id: mission:Trash Fire Crops|As you move about the spaceport, you can't avoid the terrible smell. It's like a trash fire, but you can't see any sort of smoke.|153|0
units.english: As you move about the spaceport, you can't avoid the terrible smell. It's like a trash fire, but you can't see any sort of smoke.
units.italian: Mentre ti muovi per lo spazioporto non puoi evitare il terribile odore. È come un rogo di rifiuti, ma non vedi nessun tipo di fumo.

units.id: mission:Trash Fire Crops|	(Ignore it.)|155|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignoralo.)

units.id: mission:Trash Fire Crops|	(Ask around.)|157|0
units.english: (Ask around.)
units.italian: (Chiedi in giro.)

units.id: mission:Trash Fire Crops|	You ask one of the locals who doesn't look too busy. They sadly inform you that there's been a bumper banana crop, but unfortunately other wealthier worlds had a bumper crop at the same time, and there's nowhere to either sell or store a significant excess. Distressed farmers are burning the excess fruit to make fertilizer for the next season, the wind has carried the smell all over town.|158|0
units.english: You ask one of the locals who doesn't look too busy. They sadly inform you that there's been a bumper banana crop, but unfortunately other wealthier worlds had a bumper crop at the same time, and there's nowhere to either sell or store a significant excess. Distressed farmers are burning the excess fruit to make fertilizer for the next season, the wind has carried the smell all over town.
units.italian: Chiedi a uno dei locali che non sembra troppo occupato. Ti informa con tristezza che c'è stato un raccolto eccezionale di banane, ma sfortunatamente altri mondi più ricchi hanno avuto un raccolto eccezionale nello stesso periodo, e non c'è posto dove vendere o conservare un surplus così grande. Gli agricoltori in difficoltà bruciano la frutta in eccesso per fare fertilizzante per la stagione successiva, e il vento ha portato l'odore per tutta la città.

units.id: mission:Trash Fire Crops|	You leave the mysterious smell to the locals and continue on your business.|161|0
units.english: You leave the mysterious smell to the locals and continue on your business.
units.italian: Lasci l'odore misterioso ai locali e torni alle tue faccende.

units.id: mission:Worker's Occasion|Pausing to consider a restaurant for your dinner, you notice a local worker with a small handful of credits eagerly eyeing the menu. His clothes are neatly worn and look freshly brushed, but it's impossible not to notice the dirty marks and stains that haven't washed out. The man undeniably seems nervous, and he looks at the formal dining layout with an obvious lack of familiarity. Looking at the menu yourself, you realize that while the prices are very affordable for you, they would've been unreachable before your career change.|177|0
units.english: Pausing to consider a restaurant for your dinner, you notice a local worker with a small handful of credits eagerly eyeing the menu. His clothes are neatly worn and look freshly brushed, but it's impossible not to notice the dirty marks and stains that haven't washed out. The man undeniably seems nervous, and he looks at the formal dining layout with an obvious lack of familiarity. Looking at the menu yourself, you realize that while the prices are very affordable for you, they would've been unreachable before your career change.
units.italian: Sostando a considerare un ristorante per la cena, noti un operaio locale con un pugno di crediti che guarda con desiderio il menù. I suoi vestiti sono consumati con ordine e sembrano appena spazzolati, ma è impossibile non notare le macchie e le tracce di sporco che non sono andate via. L'uomo sembra indubbiamente nervoso, e guarda la disposizione formale della sala con un'evidente mancanza di familiarità. Guardando il menù anche tu, ti rendi conto che i prezzi, per te molto accessibili, sarebbero stati irraggiungibili prima del tuo cambio di carriera.

units.id: mission:Worker's Occasion|	(Offer to pay for the man's dinner.)|179|0
units.english: (Offer to pay for the man's dinner.)
units.italian: (Offriti di pagare la cena all'uomo.)

units.id: mission:Worker's Occasion|	(Silently pity the man.)|181|0
units.english: (Silently pity the man.)
units.italian: (Compatiscilo in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Worker's Occasion|	(Smile at the man.)|183|0
units.english: (Smile at the man.)
units.italian: (Sorridi all'uomo.)

units.id: mission:Worker's Occasion|	You smile at the man and reflect on the value of small achievements. He catches your smile out of the corner of his eye and gives you a hesitant but friendly wave back before you go about your business.|184|0
units.english: You smile at the man and reflect on the value of small achievements. He catches your smile out of the corner of his eye and gives you a hesitant but friendly wave back before you go about your business.
units.italian: Sorridi all'uomo e rifletti sul valore dei piccoli traguardi. Lui coglie il tuo sorriso con la coda dell'occhio e ti ricambia con un cenno esitante ma amichevole prima che tu torni alle tue faccende.

units.id: mission:Worker's Occasion|	You enter the restaurant and catch the man's attention, offering to pay for his meal.|187|0
units.english: You enter the restaurant and catch the man's attention, offering to pay for his meal.
units.italian: Entri nel ristorante e attiri l'attenzione dell'uomo, offrendoti di pagargli il pasto.

units.id: mission:Worker's Occasion|	He recognizes you as a pilot and frowns, before telling you where you can stick that offer in colorful terms. As you walk away, you think about what your reaction would be if a much wealthier individual pitied you by paying for your dinner.|188|0
units.english: He recognizes you as a pilot and frowns, before telling you where you can stick that offer in colorful terms. As you walk away, you think about what your reaction would be if a much wealthier individual pitied you by paying for your dinner.
units.italian: Ti riconosce come pilota e si acciglia, poi ti dice, in termini coloriti, dove puoi ficcarti quell'offerta. Mentre ti allontani, pensi a quale sarebbe la tua reazione se una persona molto più ricca ti compatisse pagandoti la cena.

units.id: mission:Worker's Occasion|	You pity the man who has to work a full month to afford this and continue on your way.|191|0
units.english: You pity the man who has to work a full month to afford this and continue on your way.
units.italian: Compatisci l'uomo che deve lavorare un mese intero per permetterselo e prosegui per la tua strada.

units.id: mission:Paradise Cleaner Incident|Visiting the Paradise spaceports is always an interesting experience for someone from abroad. Nowhere else is class such an ingrained component of daily life. You find yourself noticing people who seem to be invisible to most of those going about their business, but they never catch your eye. They always appear to be doing their utmost to avoid notice.|207|0
units.english: Visiting the Paradise spaceports is always an interesting experience for someone from abroad. Nowhere else is class such an ingrained component of daily life. You find yourself noticing people who seem to be invisible to most of those going about their business, but they never catch your eye. They always appear to be doing their utmost to avoid notice.
units.italian: Visitare gli spazioporti di Paradise è sempre un'esperienza interessante per chi viene da fuori. In nessun altro luogo la classe è una componente così radicata della vita quotidiana. Ti ritrovi a notare persone che sembrano invisibili ai più, ma loro non incrociano mai il tuo sguardo. Sembrano sempre fare del loro meglio per non farsi notare.

units.id: mission:Paradise Cleaner Incident|	You haven't noticed children that look poor here in the past, but on this occasion you spot one as he knocks over a mop and bucket... right in front of a businessman and his family rolling their bags through the spaceport. You've never seen someone go so deathly pale as the cleaner, the boy's mother, who scurries to fix things before the man even draws a breath.|208|0
units.english: You haven't noticed children that look poor here in the past, but on this occasion you spot one as he knocks over a mop and bucket... right in front of a businessman and his family rolling their bags through the spaceport. You've never seen someone go so deathly pale as the cleaner, the boy's mother, who scurries to fix things before the man even draws a breath.
units.italian: In passato non avevi notato bambini che sembrassero poveri qui, ma in questa occasione ne vedi uno che rovescia un mocio e un secchio... proprio davanti a un uomo d'affari e alla sua famiglia che trascinano le valigie per lo spazioporto. Non hai mai visto qualcuno diventare così pallido come la donna delle pulizie, la madre del bambino, che si precipita a sistemare le cose prima ancora che l'uomo tiri il fiato.

units.english: A pair of security officers appear almost immediately, before you could intercede one way or the other, as the man and his family begin to complain. One officer provides assurances as the other supervises the cleaner, who quickly hurries her child out of harm's way.
units.italian: Un paio di agenti di sicurezza compaiono quasi subito, prima che tu possa intervenire in un modo o nell'altro, mentre l'uomo e la sua famiglia cominciano a lamentarsi. Un agente fornisce rassicurazioni mentre l'altro sorveglia la donna delle pulizie, che porta rapidamente il figlio fuori dai guai.
